title: PREPARATION AND SOME PROPERTIES OF A NEW COMPOUND CONTAINING MoO3, Al2O3 AND SiO2
abstract: Abstract                A new compound containing MoO3, Al2O3 and SiO2 was prepared by heating their mixture in a proper proportion at 1200°C for 12 hours. This compound was obtained in the form of small needle-like crystals, whose colour is slightly pale gray. Its composition was determined to be \frac16MoO3·Al2O3·2SiO2 by the chemical analysis. Crystallographic properties and preparative method of this compound were discussed in this report.
